ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio consists of approximately 85% low-intensity dark grey pixels versus 15% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels localized to scar tissue and surface disruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark grey field. High-density white linear streaks concentrated in the upper-medial regions of both lobes. Distinctive contiguous white patch located on the inner-medial region of the left lobe. Isolated high-intensity circular nodes on the distal-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees and a deep vertical pixel-offset from the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency jagged variations along the trailing edge, featuring irregular peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the distal tips, transitioning to a steep linear slope toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of roughly circular high-contrast white rings detected on the terminal region of the right lobe, consistent with barnacle attachment scars.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Widespread network of intersecting, high-contrast linear marks (rake marks) covering approximately 60% of the visible surface area, particularly dense on the upper sections of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive and dense rake-mark scarring across both lobes; significant focal scarring on the terminal edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density intersection of linear abrasions in the upper-central region where the lobes meet.
